ValidationRule.description: The Reasons Not Returning must have a value if Type is "Continued Enrollment" and Student's Intension is "Not Returning"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Reasons_Not_Returning__c ), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Continued Enrollment"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Student_Intention__c,"Not returning ever"), ISPICKVAL(Student_Intention__c,"Not returning temporarily") ), RecordTypeId = '012d00000021xGK' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Reason(s) Not Returning is required when Student's Intention is "Not returning" and Type is "Continued Enrollment"
